title: Household-Income Adjustment by Borrower Count, Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant
content:
The Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant award takes a household-income adjustment set by the number of borrowers on the loan file — the number of borrowers on the application whose credit is pulled, as recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File. The adjustment is added to the grant award with its sign, ahead of the lowering to the program's credit cap and the rounding to the cent.

**Rule.** A loan file with one borrower adds 200.00, a loan file with three or more borrowers subtracts 200.00, and a loan file with two borrowers adds nothing.

| Borrowers on the loan file | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 1 | adds 200.00 |
| 2 | adds nothing |
| 3 | subtracts 200.00 |
| 4 or more | subtracts 200.00 |

### Basis questions

**Who is counted?** The count is the number of borrowers on the application whose credit is pulled, as the loan file records it.

**Is the adjustment ever more than 200.00?** No; three borrowers and five borrowers both subtract 200.00.
